name: Prospector Whelgar
summary: At Whelgar's Excavation Site, Prospector Whelgar's search for titan relics has stalled. Vicious raptors overran the dig, and he seeks hardy adventurers to recover ancient artifacts.

sections.title: A Dig Under Siege
sections.body: Prospector Whelgar leads a dwarven dig in the Wetlands. His camp, Whelgar's Excavation Site, lies east of Menethil Harbor, where he searches for the history of the dwarven race. Ancient stone relics once filled the valley, but territorial raptors drove his team into hiding. Whelgar refuses to leave his duty unfinished. He still hopes to recover valuable relics, including the Goaz Stone, before predators or rival scoundrels ruin the site.

faq.answer: Prospector Whelgar leads an Ironforge dwarf expedition in the Wetlands. East of Menethil Harbor, he oversees a dig where he studies relics from the dawn of dwarven history.

faq.q: Where can I find Prospector Whelgar?
faq.answer: You can find Prospector Whelgar sheltering on a ridge above Whelgar's Excavation Site, east of Menethil Harbor and southwest of Dun Modr in the Wetlands.

faq.q: Why is Whelgar having trouble at the dig site?
faq.answer: Fierce native raptors have overrun the dig, killing or scattering Whelgar's crew and forcing him into a defensive pocket. He cannot continue unearthing relics without protection.

The Goaz Stone is an ancient artifact uncovered among the ruins at Whelgar's excavation site. Whelgar is working to translate its inscriptions to learn more about the forgotten origins and ancient history of the dwarven people.

angles.text: As a dwarf, Whelgar's mission serves the Explorers' League and King Magni Bronzebeard's search into the titan roots of the dwarven race.
As a miner, you can find rich mineral veins in the craggy ridges around Whelgar's dig site. Raptors also roam the area and plague his team.
